caption: Basilica di Superga, Turin
composition: Baroque hilltop basilica with dome and twin towers overlooking Turin and the Alps · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the balustraded terrace, the camera frames the Basilica di Superga against the vast panorama of Turin and the Alps in the clear 11:23 morning. The great dome and twin bell towers rise at the left, their pale stonework gleaming, while the city sprawls across the plain at center-right and the snow-capped Alps march along the horizon behind. The bright daylight gives the whole scene a crisp, elevated clarity worthy of the hilltop viewpoint.
